decision: Earnings state how much is still inside the 30-day return window
why: Creators plan around money; showing unconfirmed amounts as earned creates disappointment.

decision: Joining a campaign creates a rule-scoped enrollment, not a new code
why: Creators keep one code; campaign rules decide the rate per item.
value: Audiences see one code and attribution stays clean.

decision: Payouts are explained as a four-step flow with dates
why: Most creator support tickets are 'where is my money'.
value: Creators can answer the question themselves.

decision: Caption suggestions are drafts the creator edits, never auto-posted
why: A creator's voice is their product.
